title: Bitter Taste Story Data
description: Schema for assets/story.json defining memory nodes, flexible chain completion, and decoupled wave triggers.

intro_subtitle.description: Subtitle shown when Act I begins.

starting_nodes.description: Node IDs that start visible in the void.

outro_trigger_chain.description: Ordered sequence of chain steps required to finish Act II and enter Act III. Each step is either a single node ID or an array of node IDs allowed in any order as a contiguous block.

outro_subtitle.description: Subtitle shown when outro_trigger_chain is completed.

nodes.description: Dictionary mapping unique node IDs to memory node definitions.

triggers.description: One-shot wave triggers decoupled from individual edges. Each trigger fires at most once.

nodeId.description: Unique snake_case identifier for a memory node.

chainStep.description: A single required node ID, or an array of node IDs that may appear in any order as a contiguous sub-sequence.

text.description: Memory fragment text displayed inside the square.

is_clean.description: True for Act I surface memories; false for repressed truths and ending beats.

outgoing.description: Valid target node IDs mapped to an optional narrator comment. Empty string "" means a silent connection. Plays whenever the connection is made (including after unhooking and reconnecting).

when_connected.description: Fires once any contiguous sub-chain matches this ChainStep sequence (supporting single IDs and any-order arrays, identical to outro_trigger_chain).

when_same_chain.description: Fires once all listed node IDs belong to the same connected chain in any order, even with other nodes inserted between them.

spawns.description: Node IDs to fade into the void if not already visible.

subtitle.description: Optional one-shot narrator subtitle played when this trigger fires.
